description.p: A lightweight gaming system monitor, made to sit on a second screen while you play. It shows CPU, GPU, RAM and VRAM usage, temperatures and FPS with real-time graphs, session statistics and your controller's battery level.

ul.li: CPU, GPU, RAM and VRAM gauges with temperatures and trend graphs
FPS, 1% low, 0.1% low and frametime, with a CPU/GPU bottleneck indicator
Controller card: model, wired or Bluetooth connection and battery level
Light and dark themes, English and French interface

description.p: FPS data comes from the log files written by MangoHud, so MangoHud must be installed and its logging enabled. This is an independent community project and is not affiliated with the CachyOS team.
